content:
**Fixed new-change.mjs scaffold missing spec.md (issue #249)**

**What**: `brain/scripts/new-change.mjs` scaffolded only `proposal.md`, `design.md`, `tasks.md` for a new SDD change — never `spec.md`, even though `harness-contract.md` and `docs/workflow-guide.md` both document 4 required artifacts. Added a `spec.md` template (frontmatter + "Requisitos delta"/"Escenarios" sections, mirroring the other three's Spanish style) and wired it into the write sequence + console.log summary.
**Why**: Approved issue #249 — pure manual (no-AI) flow silently produced only 3 of 4 required artifacts.
**Where**: brain/scripts/new-change.mjs (+16/-1), new test brain/scripts/new-change.test.mjs (RED→GREEN, spawns the script from an isolated tmp copy).
**Learned**: new-change.mjs computes `repoRoot` from its OWN script location (`dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))/../..`), not `cwd`. To test it without polluting the real repo's `openspec/changes/`, copy the script into a tmp dir mirroring `brain/scripts/new-change.mjs` (so repoRoot resolves inside tmp) and spawn `node` on the copy — same pattern used by check-refs.test.mjs for its rules fixture. Centralizing the artifact list into a shared module is explicitly out of scope (deferred to B0 / issue #250).
